anchors.note: Pixel within each sprite that sits exactly on the spline endpoint. Rotate about this point to the local tangent.

markings.renderOrder: above body rope, below head and tail

notes: body.png is seamless — right edge cross-fades into left. Tile or stretch freely.
body.png spans full texture height with no vertical padding; the rope maps texture height to rope width.
head.png and tail.png are cut from the original curved art, so they are undistorted.
